analyst_view.overall: Early view: José Mourinho's Real Madrid (2nd, five straight league wins) host Osasuna, 16th with one win in five. Madrid play at Arsenal in the Champions League on the Wednesday before, so rotation is likely. Rodrygo and Raúl Asencio are working back from injury, and one report says Aurélien Tchouaméni had a groin problem with France on 10 November.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals. I lean slightly lower: with a midweek trip to Arsenal, Madrid may rotate and ease off once ahead.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners. Madrid should have most of the ball against a deep Osasuna; I see nothing pushing this either way.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.5 cards. Osasuna usually defend with intensity away at big sides, which the model already reflects; Jon Moncayola's ban should be served well before this game.

shots.text: The numbers say 30.6 shots. A rotated Madrid still usually produces volume at the Bernabéu, so I stay with the model.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.0 shots on target. With Mbappé, Bellingham and Güler likely involved in some form, nothing points away from the model.
